architecture.mechanism: Optimization of container configuration parameters to reduce startup overhead
architecture.intervention: Apply parameter optimization to the embedded software modules governing vehicle network wake-up sequences to minimize the duration and power consumption of spurious wake events.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduction in cumulative parasitic drain during extended parking by decreasing the time and resources required for modules to initialize and return to sleep states.
architecture.falsification_test: Measure total current draw over a 72-hour parking simulation with induced spurious wake events before and after applying the optimized module configuration parameters.
